# 在线运行演示：导入标准库 + 简单数据 + 输出结果
# （需要读入数据？展开下方「标准输入」即可用 input() 读取。）
import math
from collections import Counter


def main() -> None:
    nums = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2, 6]
    text = "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the fox"

    print("Hello from Python in the browser!")
    print("输入 nums =", nums)
    print("最大值 =", max(nums), "| 平均值 =", round(sum(nums) / len(nums), 2))
    print(f"sqrt(2) = {math.sqrt(2):.4f}  (来自 math 模块)")
    print("词频 Top3 =", Counter(text.split()).most_common(3))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

-- 在线运行演示：Lua 5.4（wasmoon / WebAssembly，纯浏览器运行）
local nums = {3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2, 6}
local text = "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the fox"

print("Hello from Lua in the browser!")

local maxVal, sum = nums[1], 0
for _, n in ipairs(nums) do
  if n > maxVal then maxVal = n end
  sum = sum + n
end

print("输入 nums 数量 =", #nums)
print("最大值 =", maxVal, "| 平均值 =", string.format("%.2f", sum / #nums))
print("sqrt(2) =", string.format("%.4f", math.sqrt(2)))

local counter = {}
for word in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do
  counter[word] = (counter[word] or 0) + 1
end
local ranked = {}
for word, n in pairs(counter) do
  table.insert(ranked, { word, n })
end
table.sort(ranked, function(a, b) return a[2] > b[2] end)
local top = {}
for i = 1, math.min(3, #ranked) do
  table.insert(top, ranked[i][1] .. ":" .. ranked[i][2])
end
print("词频 Top3 =", table.concat(top, ", "))
